Nest 0.1.1 adds a terminal you share with your agents, split panes, mid-run steering and a much larger Settings screen, and closes several ways an agent could widen its own permissions. Nest is now licensed under **GPL-3.0-only**.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 (x64) | `Nest-Setup-0.1.1-b45.exe` — NSIS installer, per-user, desktop + Start Menu shortcuts |
| Linux (x64) | `Nest-0.1.1.AppImage` — portable, `chmod +x` and run |
| Debian / Ubuntu (x64) | `nest_0.1.1_amd64.deb` — `sudo apt install ./nest_0.1.1_amd64.deb` |

Existing installs pick this up through the in-app updater.

## New

- **Shared terminal** — each chat gets its own shell in its working folder, in a resizable panel under the transcript. You type into it directly; agents use `terminal_run`, `terminal_read` and `terminal_send_keys` (with named keys like `ctrl+c`, so they can stop what they started). Off by default: turn it on per agent under Settings > Connectors & tools, or "Let <agent> use it" in the panel. "Always ask before terminal commands" is on by default, even for agents that skip permissions; Ctrl-C never asks. macOS/Linux get a real pty; Windows uses PowerShell over pipes.
- **Split panes** — drag a chat from the sidebar onto either half of an open chat to dock it side by side. Panes resize and remember their layout.
- **Steer a running agent** — a message sent while the agent works reaches it mid-turn (Claude Code over stdin, Codex via `turn/steer`) instead of waiting for the run to end.
- **Settings**
  - Appearance: accent colour, dim or true-black dark, interface size (80–130%), density, custom interface and code fonts, reduce motion, reset.
  - Default model per provider; choose which events notify and whether they play a sound; list and create database backups.
  - Saves apply instantly, and provider CLIs are re-detected only when a path or the API-billing switch changes.
- **Routines run in their project** — each run's chat is created in the schedule's project with its brief, memory and teammates, instead of loose in the sidebar. Agents get `update_schedule` and `update_project`; the routine editor has a "Works in" picker.
- **Phones** use the full width: separate list and editor screens for agents, wider replies, always-visible reply actions, compact model picker.
- Nest logo in the sidebar.

## Security

- `delegate` asks first (unless the caller already skips permissions), since the target may have broader access.
- `remember` with shared or project scope asks first, since those notes reach other agents' prompts.
- `create_agent`, `update_agent`, `create_schedule` and `update_my_instructions` ask even when permissions are skipped, so skipping can't spread.
- A paired phone can no longer set or clear stored API keys, or change an agent's terminal access.

## Fixes

- Copy buttons work — they previously failed silently because Electron's clipboard write was refused.
- Claude: stopping before the CLI launched no longer runs the turn unseen, and a CLI that fails to spawn ends the turn instead of hanging it and Stop.
- Clicking a field's label no longer presses its first button (e.g. clearing handoff context).
- A database from another branch's build no longer blocks startup migrations.

## Notes

- Installers are unsigned. Windows SmartScreen and Linux desktops may warn on first run.
